firewall_investigation.finding: Docker adds a container's drop-direct-access rules when the container starts, so recreating containers swaps the order of three pure-match drop rules sharing one verdict; the raw hash has exactly two values, and the earlier BEFORE/AFTER pair was those two values. No packet meets a different rule.
